proof_body:
by
  intro X _ _ A B hA hB hd
  obtain ⟨f, h0, h1, h⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed hA hB hd
  exact ⟨f, f.continuous, fun x hx => h0 hx, fun x hx => h1 hx, fun x => h x⟩
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [NormalSpace X] (A B : Set X), IsClosed A → IsClosed B → Disjoint A B → ∃ f : X → ℝ, Continuous f ∧ (∀ x ∈ A, f x = 0) ∧ (∀ x ∈ B, f x = 1) ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1
